GOLD COAST / COMMERCIAL SERVICES

Façade & high-access cleaning

We plan façade and high-access cleaning around the building material, soiling and access method. We assess adjacent windows, coatings, landscaping and pedestrian routes before agreeing the cleaning approach. On coastal buildings, sheltered surfaces can need particular attention because normal rainfall may not wash them.

What we can look after

  • External walls, cladding and agreed high-level surfaces.
  • Sheltered façade areas with accumulated salt, dirt or staining.
  • Access planning, protection and cleaning-water control.

Planning the work

  1. We identify surface materials, condition and access constraints.
  2. We agree the cleaning method, test areas and protection arrangements.
  3. We review the cleaned areas and record any defects revealed during cleaning.

Questions about this service

Do all exterior surfaces need pressure washing?+

We choose the method after checking the material, coating, joints and condition. We agree the appropriate pressure, cleaning product and protection for the specific surface, with a test area where needed.
